Dixon Residential Estate Agents, The Dublin Property Experts, are delighted to present Apartment 7, Christchurch View to the Dublin 8 property market.

This superb apartment offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, and investors alike to acquire a spacious, well-appointed home in a highly sought-after city location, just a short stroll from Dublin City Centre.

The fabulously renovated home comprises of an exceptionally spacious open-plan living, dining, and kitchen area, creating the perfect space for both everyday living and entertaining. The property also features a generous double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, a well-designed bathroom, and the added benefit of a separate storage closet.

Apartment 7, Christchurch View enjoys an enviable location within walking distance of Christchurch, Smithfield, Stoneybatter, and Dublin City Centre. Residents are surrounded by an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, shops, and cultural attractions, including the Jameson Distillery, Guinness Storehouse, and the Four Courts. The LUAS Red Line is just minutes away, providing fast and convenient access to the city and beyond.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a quality apartment in one of Dublin's most convenient and vibrant locations. Early viewing is highly recommended.
